method: Checksum-bound FGS planning frame, extended in depth cycle 1 with the two UNESCO ICH elements on which Somalia appears, the 2020 ratification of both conventions, the three 2024-2025 tentative-list submissions, seven articles of the 2012 Provisional Constitution, the ISO 639-3 registration for Somali, and Arabic/English mirror material for language presence, cuisine and culture.
scope_rule: The 7-FMS denominator is explicitly the current Ministry of Planning frame, not a neutral sovereignty/control adjudication.
